summary: Frontend E2E validation of VETMECH B2B checkout enhancements (terms gating, T&C popup, cash-discount, order-origin capture, admin reflection). Logged in as customer 9000000123 via WhatsApp OTP (dev_otp captured from POST /api/auth/otp/request response). Added VETKCLOR 100 ml (VKC-100) qty 22 to cart and went to /checkout. Verified: (1) Confirm Order button (data-testid confirm-order-btn) is DISABLED before ticking terms; (2) Clicking 'Terms & Conditions' link (view-terms-btn) opens the terms-dialog with the full T&C text (6 numbered clauses + closing line, ~581 chars); (3) Ticking terms-checkbox enables Confirm; (4) Ticking cash-discount-checkbox + terms and pressing Confirm posts to /api/orders successfully (HTTP 200) and navigates to /order-confirmed/{id}. Response payload contains accept_terms=true, cash_discount=true, and full origin object {ip: 34.16.56.64, browser: Chrome, os: Linux, device: Desktop, location: 'Council Bluffs, Iowa, United States', user_agent, timezone, screen 1440x900, language, captured_at}. Delivery address defaulted to saved address (Clinic Rd, Ahmedabad, Gujarat - 380001). Admin (vetmechpharma@gmail.com / Admin@123) -> /admin/orders -> viewed order VM-2026-00026 in the detail sheet: cash-discount-flag renders 'CASH DISCOUNT BILL (4%) REQUESTED' (amber highlight), order-origin block shows 'Desktop · Chrome · Linux', 'IP 34.16.56.64 · Council Bluffs, Iowa, United States', 'UTC · 1440x900'. Admin address block matches the checkout saved address exactly.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor a11y console warning on the customer login dialog: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for screen reader users'. Not a blocker, but wrap the AuthDialog title in VisuallyHidden or add a DialogTitle to silence the Radix warning.

The auto-detected origin.location for the test container reads 'Council Bluffs, Iowa, United States' (GCP egress via ip-api). This is expected in preview env but worth surfacing to admins as 'best-effort' or falling back to '—' when geo is a datacenter to avoid confusing real order origin diagnostics.
Consider adding a small helper text next to the cash-discount checkbox on checkout explaining that the 4% is applied by admin on the invoice (customer sees it as an option, not a live discount).
